name: Love ritual
source:
Love Ritual will put you in the shoes of a woman named Riilai, a professional scientist with extensive knowledge on occult magic. In a big case, the police reach out to her family in order to investigate whether or not a ritual took place at the crime scene. Riilai goes to the city to assist on the investigation as an expert in the hopes of getting a lead to the suspect.

Riilai will have to face the two advocates for the two primary suspects, and her relationships will start to change!
translation:
《爱情仪式》将让你化身为莉莱，一名精通神秘魔法的专业科学家。警方遇到一桩大案，联系她的家人，希望调查案发现场是否举行过某种仪式。莉莱前往城市，以专家身份协助调查，希望找到嫌疑人的线索。

莉莱将面对两名主要嫌疑人的辩护人，而她的人际关系也会开始发生变化！
